''simultaneous broadcast'' | runtime = | ratings = | producer = | director = | most_awards = | most_nominations = | website = {{URL|www.sagawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[24th Screen Actors Guild Awards|24th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[26th Screen Actors Guild Awards|26th]] }} The 25th Annual [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2018, were presented on January 27, 2019 at the [[Shrine Auditorium]] in Los Angeles, California.{{cite news |last=McNary |first=Dave |title=SAG Awards: 'Black Panther,' 'Mrs. Maisel,' 'This Is Us' Take Ensemble Prizes |url=https://variety.com/2019/film/awards/sag-awards-2019-winners-1203119853/ |access-date=January 28, 2019 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 27, 2019}}{{cite web |last=Hipes |first=Patrick |title=SAG Awards: 'Black Panther' Wins Best Ensemble; 'Mrs. Maisel' Sweeps And 'This Is Us' Repeats On TV Side – Complete List Of Winners |url=https://deadline.com/2019/01/2019-sag-awards-winners-list-1202542919/ |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=January 28, 2019 |date=January 27, 2019}}{{cite news |title=Submissions for 25th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards® Close on Monday, Oct. 22, 2018 |url=http://sagawards.org/media/news/releases/submissions-25th-annual-screen-actors-guild-awards®-close-monday-oct-22-2018 |access-date=November 30, 2018 |publisher=[[SAG-AFTRA]] |date=October 18, 2018}} The ceremony was broadcast live on both [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] and [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]] 8:00 p.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] / 5:00 p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]]. The nominees were announced December 12, 2018 alongside the announcement of [[Megan Mullally]] as the ceremony's host.{{cite news |title=SAG Award Nominations: Complete List |url=https://variety.com/2018/film/news/2019-sag-award-nominations-list-nominees-1203087472/ |access-date=December 29, 2018 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=December 12, 2018}}{{cite news |last=Nordyke |first=Kimberly |title=SAG Awards: 'A Star Is Born' Tops Film Noms; 'Mrs. Maisel,' 'Ozark' Lead TV |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/2019-sag-nominations-complete-list-1166352 |access-date=December 29, 2018 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=December 12, 2018}}{{cite web |last=Pedersen |first=Erik |title=SAG Awards Sets Megan Mullally As Host |url=https://deadline.com/2018/12/megan-mullally-to-host-sag-awards-2019-1202518778/ |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=December 12, 2018 |date=December 12, 2018}} [[Alan Alda]] was announced as the 2018 SAG Life Achievement Award recipient on October 4, 2018.{{cite news |last=McNary |first=Dave |title=Alan Alda to Receive SAG Life Achievement Award |url=https://variety.com/2018/film/news/alan-alda-sag-life-achievement-award-1202968585/ |access-date=November 30, 2018 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=October 4, 2018}} ==Winners and nominees== ''Note'': Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''boldface'''.
